cohort: The study included 420 postnatal women randomly recruited from five primary health facilities and 10 ANC service providers from these facilities.
finding: High-quality antenatal care was associated with significantly lower odds of delivering low birth weight babies (AOR = 0.13) and preterm babies (AOR = 0.15).
cross-section timing: Postnatal (at a single point after birth, reflecting on the preceding pregnancy and birth outcomes)
